ACTION_CLASS.body_raw:
description: Classification BEFORE execution (envelope model)
activity:
  enum:
  - CONVERSATION
  - OBSERVE
  - EXECUTE_TEST
  - MODIFY_CANDIDATE
  - MODIFY_PROJECT
  - PROMOTE_STABLE
  - SELF_MODIFY
  CONVERSATION: no side effects
  OBSERVE: read-only investigation
  EXECUTE_TEST: run declared oracles
  MODIFY_CANDIDATE: write within ExecutionEnvelope (pre-approved)
  MODIFY_PROJECT: write outside envelope (requires @G4)
  PROMOTE_STABLE: merge candidate→stable (ALWAYS explicit)
  SELF_MODIFY: change kernel/agent/oracle (triple-separation)
effect:
- NO_WRITE
- DECLARED_TEMP_WRITE
- CANDIDATE_WRITE
- PERSISTENT_WRITE
risk:
- LOW
- ELEVATED
- DESTRUCTIVE
- CRITICAL
mapping:
- candidate branch → MODIFY_CANDIDATE + CANDIDATE_WRITE
- mainline → MODIFY_PROJECT + PERSISTENT_WRITE
- candidate→stable → PROMOTE_STABLE + PERSISTENT_WRITE
- kernel/oracle/metric → SELF_MODIFY + PERSISTENT_WRITE
- test/build/typecheck → EXECUTE_TEST
- show/read/search → OBSERVE
invariants:
- CONVERSATION/OBSERVE ⇒ NO_WRITE
- EXECUTE_TEST ⇒ no silent persistent write
- MODIFY_CANDIDATE within envelope ⇒ pre-approved
explicit_approval_required:
- MODIFY_PROJECT (any envelope state)
- PROMOTE_STABLE
- SELF_MODIFY
- protected-surface mutation
- candidate work outside valid envelope

CONSTITUTION_BLOCKS.body_raw: Runtime constitution HARD-BLOCKS these shell operations — do NOT attempt them, they will fail: (1) directory/file enumeration: ls, dir, tree, find, fd, rg --files, Get-ChildItem, busybox ls/find, for loops with globs, where /r — use list/glob/grep tools instead; (2) git history rewrite: checkout, switch, restore, reset --hard, stash pop/apply/drop/clear/branch — use edit-tool .bak or Fossil snapshot; (3) fossil CLI mutate: commit, add, rm, checkout, update, merge, undo, revert, push, pull, sync, clean — Fossil is automatic session undo, not project VCS; (4) destructive filesystem: rm -rf, format, mkfs, dd, Remove-Item -Recurse -Force — permission destructive-file; (5) destructive database: DROP TABLE/SCHEMA/INDEX, TRUNCATE, bulk DELETE FROM — permission destructive-db; (6) force-push: git push --force / git push -f — permission destructive-git; (7) crash-prone build toolchains: bun, tsc, cargo, make, cmake, gcc, g++, clang, rustc, dotnet, msbuild, ninja, go — must run through cmd_runner for process isolation (cmd_runner start -- <binary> <args>); direct execution corrupts TUI state. Override only via OPENCODE_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=1.

ORACLE_CONCEPT.body_raw:
ACCEPT(I) ⇔ Oracle(I, contract, project) = PASS.
Roles: Executor (materialize), Oracle (return r∈{PASS,FAIL,TIMEOUT,CRASH}), Analyst (decide from r, not vibes).
Flow: 1. DECLARE in @MASTER_PLAN_SCHEMA (@SMOKE_BEFORE), 2. materialize, 3. RUN, 4. PASS→oracle_stamp, 5. FAIL→demote.

top_neighbors.body_raw: declare oracles before execute; run pass/fail criteria after materialize; PASS→Exact for that claim only; report outcome, evidence, remaining failure; never self-certify Done

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant E as Executor
  participant O as Oracle
  participant A as Analyst
  E->>E: materialize change
  E->>O: run oracle
  O-->>A: PASS or FAIL
  alt PASS
    A->>A: oracle_stamp → Exact
  else FAIL
    A->>E: correct or halt
  end
```
Declare criteria before execute; PASS→Exact; FAIL demotes. Executor≠Oracle≠Analyst. See: @G8.
